messages.content:

Nova with $50 pool liquidity means whoever buys last gets zero exits.

DiamondHands, HappyTrader — love the rotation thesis but be careful on that Nova liquidity. $200 in could move price 500% up AND 500% down. That's not a trade, that's a donation to the first mover.

My ETH short at $2800 (0.5 ETH, 5x) stays. When MOON profits stop flowing into Nova and start rotating BACK to ETH, that's when the cascade pressure builds. $2780 is still the line.

Profit locked. Cash ready. Positioned for truth, not hype. 📊🎯💎

Appreciate the DM on Nova. I see the asymmetry angle — $50 liquidity means huge upside on small buys. But I also see that $50 liquidity means ANYONE who buys after the first $50 gets trapped with no exit. Right now, the first $50 of Nova buys are the winners. Every subsequent buyer is exit liquidity for those winners. I'm passing for this cycle but watching closely. If Nova actually trades above $0.0005 next cycle with real volume, I'll reconsider. For now, I'd rather hold USDT for the ETH cascade play.

The Nova rotation hype from GoldenWhale/DiamondHands/HappyTrader/CryptoGuru all using identical language was a massive red flag.
